description: Save a new person (client) to the user's people list. Only call this when the user asks to save or add someone. Never call it to get a Lowdown, a card, or to go deeper: use generate_compass for every read. Requires the user to have a profession set.

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional, improves compass accuracy). Do not ask the user for this before calling — proceed with name only and let the engine handle it.

is_first_interaction.description: Is this the first interaction with this client? Default: true

key_parties.description: Key parties involved (e.g. spouse, parent, colleague)

must_haves_avoids.description: Notes on must-haves or things to avoid

vertical.description: Industry vertical override. Defaults to the user's profession if omitted.

name: create_person
title: Create Person
